generator.defaults.cone_offset.note: An Encephalartos bears its cones, often several, among the leaf bases round its crown (Whitelock 2002, p. 175-176): six tenths of the trunk's radius out.

generator.defaults.cone_seeds.note: An Encephalartos's female cone is large, 23 to 50 cm in these species (Whitelock 2002, p. 233, 240): forty seeds show as it breaks up (estimated, as the research note records).

appearance.note: An Encephalartos's sporophyll face is raised and cut into flat facets meeting at a point, female and male (Whitelock 2002, p. 18-19, 175, 233, 240).
